newsitem.title: USA: American Claims sees business declining.
newsitem.headline: American Claims sees business declining.

text.p: American Claims Evaluation Inc, reporting lower results for its third quarter ended December 31, said Thursday that demand for hospital bill audit services had continued to decline throughout the first nine months of its fiscal year.
The lagging demand was primarily responsible for lower third quarter revenues, American Claims said.

"Management anticipates that this trend will continue as many of its clients negotiate alternative arrangements directly with hospitals and other full-service managed care entities," the company said in a statement accompanying its earnings report.
